train_text_to_code_model: train a text to code generation model using GPT-2 or RoBERTa on the CodeXGLUE dataset
evaluate_model_perplexity: evaluate the trained model on the dev set and compute perplexity scores
eval_bleu_code_generation: evaluate code generation quality using BLEU score and exact match on dev or test set
run_beam_search_inference: run beam search inference to generate code from natural language descriptions
load_resume_checkpoint: load a pretrained model and resume training from the last saved checkpoint
